13. REPLACE OIL SEAL ON SPEEDOMETER DRIVEN GEAR
(a) Using SST, remove the oil seal.
SST 09921-00010

(b) Using SST, install a new oil seal.
SST 09201-60011
Oil seal depth: 25 mm (0.98 in.)

14. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE OIL SEAL AND BUSHING
(a) Using SST, remove the oil seal.
SST 09308-00010 or
09308-10010 w/ output shaft installed
(b) Heat the extension housing to 80 - 100°C (176 - 212°F) in an oil bath.

(c) Using SST, remove the bushing and install a new bushing.
SST 09307-30010

(d) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal.
SST 09325-20010
